title: lateral wipe with objects and a tiny depth: s4 as graded (the same objects, overlap, shadow, crop), the edges keep their 62° slant but the movement is horizontal (late autumn in from the right, early autumn in from the left), 50 % slower (135 frames), and the wipe edge bends with the scene's depth by up to 60 px (near things are reached a little later than the skyline; the content never moves, every border stays registered)
gag: Three seasons from one balcony in Ivano-Frankivsk (his order: 1 summer, 2 early autumn, 3 late autumn). Summer holds; the two other seasons slide in from opposite corners along a 62° diagonal, pass each other over summer, and leave; summer remains, so the clip loops. The output is the centre 75 % of the registered canvas (3600 px prep), so a drifting picture never runs out of pixels.
